description: This source file defines the NotificationDispatcherService class, a background service that periodically processes notification outbox entries from a database, dispatches due notifications, and updates their statuses. It includes logic for polling the database, handling notifications in different states ('pending', 'processing', 'sent', 'failed'), and parsing payload JSON to validate notification data.

classes.name: NotificationDispatcherService
classes.description: A background hosted service that periodically checks for due notifications in the database, processes them, updates their statuses, and handles success or failure scenarios.

methods.name: NotificationDispatcherService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with dependency injections for the service provider and logger.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to run a polling loop that dispatches due notifications every 5 seconds, with error handling.

methods.name: ProcessDueNotifications
methods.description: Processes notifications that are scheduled and pending, marking them as processing, attempting to dispatch them, and updating their statuses accordingly.
